correctness.rationale: For every prime p, field char p and N strictly upper triangular of size p+3, (I+N)^p=I+N^p. Length-p ordered paths have displacement at least p, producing exactly six possible output coordinates (u,v,w,s,t,z). Unique all-unit paths yield three adjacent first-superdiagonal products. When v=0, u w must vanish; when v≠0,u=w=0 the internal first-superdiagonal factors are nonzero and path factorization forces vz=st. Casewise explicit assignments of first-, second- and third-superdiagonal entries from the actual proof construct preimages in every other allowed case, including the p=2 empty-product boundary; count of two disjoint obstructions is q²(q−1)(q²−1), leaving |G^p|=q^6−q^5+q^4+q^3−q². Independent 1024-element exhaustive UT5(F2) source enumeration gives exactly 52 image elements satisfying the criterion, and 1200 random prime-field matrices across p=3,5,7 satisfy the necessary conditions. These tests corroborate but do not establish the all-prime constructive theorem.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for the explicit necessary-and-sufficient six-coordinate membership criterion uniform in every prime p and char-p field and its exact finite-field polynomial. Dolfi–Singh–Yadav 2019/2021 primary article proves first nonsurjectivity at n=p+3, general image-size bounds and numerically tabulates (p,q)=(2,2),(2,4),(3,3), all of which are acknowledged as prior, but does not state the full uniform formula. Earlier characteristic-two UT5 membership is known and not claimed. The generic unitriangular root adjunction and verbal-width results concern different questions. Originality risk is an older equivalent implicit group-conjugacy or matrix image characterization.
